text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heya-hey, Trainer! Did you rest up<n>too?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to make the most of my time<n>off, so I
didn't put my name down for<n>any shifts. I haven't
felt this relaxed<n>in ages!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...But I do get antsy when there's<n>nothing to do.
Ahaha, maybe I had a<n>little too much time on my
hands.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
After all that restlessness, I think I<n>need some good
ol' training to set<n>me straight! ♪

Not only is Ines Fujin in high spirits,<n>but she seems
well rested, too!
